acts.text: Practice the song somewhere you feel completely free.
acts.explanation: Find a place where your voice feels free — even a quiet corner is enough.

acts.text: Imagine where you will be when the world sings as one.
acts.explanation: Picture the day ahead. Imagine yourself among millions, singing as one.

acts.text: Discover a Foundation created by someone you admire.
acts.explanation: Someone you admire may already be turning influence into care. Discover their Foundation.

acts.text: Read the story behind a Foundation.
acts.explanation: Behind every Foundation is a story. Take a few minutes to read one with an open heart.

acts.text: Learn about a cause you knew little about.
acts.explanation: Curiosity is peaceful. Learn about a cause you have never paused to understand.

acts.text: Explore a Foundation working to fight hunger.
acts.explanation: Hunger is a problem real people are working on. Explore Foundations fighting it today.

acts.text: Discover a project helping improve access to healthcare.
acts.explanation: Healthcare access changes lives. Discover a project working to make care more reachable.

acts.text: Learn about a Foundation supporting education.
acts.explanation: Education unlocks possibility. Learn how a Foundation is supporting learning.

acts.text: Read about a project working to protect the environment.
acts.explanation: Protecting the environment is protecting our shared home. Read about a project that cares for it.

acts.text: Explore a cause dedicated to helping children.
acts.explanation: Children deserve safety, care, and hope. Explore Foundations working where that need is real.

acts.text: Find a Foundation whose mission genuinely moves you.
acts.explanation: Let your values lead. Find a Foundation whose mission genuinely moves you.

acts.text: Read how one community is being helped through a Foundation.
acts.explanation: Impact becomes real when you see a community being helped. Read one story today.

acts.text: Discover one real problem a Foundation is working to solve.
acts.explanation: Every Foundation is answering a real problem. Discover one clearly and carefully.

acts.text: Learn how a small donation can create real change.
acts.explanation: Even small support can matter — first understand how change happens through a Foundation.

acts.text: Read an update from a Foundation you support.
acts.explanation: Stay close to the work. Read an update and notice what has changed.

acts.text: Discover a new creator who is using their influence to help others.
acts.explanation: Influence can become service. Discover a creator using their platform to help others.

acts.text: Find one project you would like to see succeed.
acts.explanation: Hope needs witnesses. Find one project you would love to see succeed.

acts.text: Spend time learning about a cause before deciding whether to support it.
acts.explanation: Wisdom before action. Learn about a cause before deciding whether to support it.

acts.text: Compare two causes and discover which one speaks to you most.
acts.explanation: Your heart knows what resonates. Compare two causes and notice which one speaks to you.

acts.text: Read about the people behind a project.
acts.explanation: Projects are people. Read about those carrying the work forward.

acts.text: Learn exactly how support is being used in one Foundation.
acts.explanation: Transparency builds trust. Learn exactly how support is being used in one Foundation.

acts.text: Discover a project outside the cause you usually care about.
acts.explanation: Stretch your compassion. Discover a project outside the cause you usually care about.

acts.text: Support a Foundation with your time, voice, skills, or donation.
acts.explanation: Support can mean time, voice, skills, or a gift — choose what feels right for you.

acts.text: Donate to an Influencer Foundation you genuinely believe in, if you can.
acts.explanation: If you can and want to, support a Foundation you genuinely believe in. Exploring first is enough.

acts.text: Share a Foundation's mission with someone who might care about it.
acts.explanation: Awareness is a form of care. Share a Foundation’s mission with someone who might care too.

acts.text: Follow the journey of one project you want to see succeed.
acts.explanation: Stay with one journey. Follow a project you want to see succeed.

acts.text: Choose one cause you would stand behind.
acts.explanation: Clarity creates commitment. Choose one cause you would stand behind.

acts.text: Make your first contribution to a cause that matters to you, if you can.
acts.explanation: If you are ready, make a first contribution to a cause that matters — only if it feels right.

acts.text: Support a project helping people in a part of the world you have never visited.
acts.explanation: Compassion has no borders. Support a project helping people somewhere new to you.

acts.text: Help spread awareness about a cause you believe deserves more attention.
acts.explanation: Some causes need more eyes. Help spread awareness about one you believe deserves attention.

acts.text: Return to a Foundation you previously discovered and see what has changed.
acts.explanation: Return with curiosity. See how a Foundation you discovered before has grown.

acts.text: Find out how many people are already supporting a project you care about.
acts.explanation: Community is already gathering. Learn how many people are supporting a project you care about.

acts.text: Read about the real-world impact created by a Foundation.
acts.explanation: Real impact deserves attention. Read about the change a Foundation has already created.

acts.text: Choose a cause and learn one practical way you could help beyond donating.
acts.explanation: Giving is only one path. Learn one practical way you could help beyond donating.

acts.text: Explore the map and see where voices are joining from today.
acts.explanation: The map is alive with voices. Explore where people are joining from today.

acts.text: Find a country where you would love to have a new World Choir friend.
acts.explanation: Friendship can begin with curiosity. Find a country where you would love a new choir friend.

acts.text: Discover how many voices have joined the world so far.
acts.explanation: Each voice is a person. Discover how many have already joined the world.

acts.text: Look at the map and find a part of the world farthest from you.
acts.explanation: Distance reminds us how large the choir can be. Find the farthest place from you on the map.

acts.text: Think about the fact that every Voice Number represents a real person.
acts.explanation: A Voice Number is not a statistic — it belongs to a real human being.

acts.text: Find three countries you hope will be represented in World Choir.
acts.explanation: Hold hope for the world. Find three countries you hope will be represented in World Choir.

acts.text: Explore the map and discover a country you know little about.
acts.explanation: Wonder is peaceful. Discover a country on the map you know little about.

acts.text: See how far World Choir has grown since you joined.
acts.explanation: Growth is a shared story. See how far World Choir has come since you joined.

acts.text: Share World Choir with one person who would understand its mission.
acts.explanation: Some missions are meant to be shared. Tell one person who would understand World Choir.

acts.text: Invite one person to add their voice to the world.
acts.explanation: One invitation can change everything. Invite someone to add their voice to the world.

acts.text: Read why another person decided to join World Choir.
acts.explanation: Stories bring us closer. Read why another person decided to join World Choir.

acts.text: Take a moment to imagine thousands of voices preparing together.
acts.explanation: Pause and feel it: thousands of voices preparing to sing as one.

acts.text: Find your Voice Number and remember that nobody else in the world has it.
acts.explanation: Your Voice Number is uniquely yours. Hold that for a moment — nobody else in the world has it.
